submitted.rationale: Out of 3 merit measurements along the Pb–Sb line, index 2 (Pb 0.675) gave the highest EQE (0.093%). It beat both the Pb2Sb2O7-stoichiometry point (index 8, 0.0075%) and the most Pb-rich point (index 0, 0.036%), which suggests a peak in the Pb-rich region around Pb≈0.65–0.70.

rejected.reason: Near 1:1 pyrochlore Pb2Sb2O7 composition; EQE 0.0075%, ~12x lower than index 2
Most Pb-rich; EQE 0.036%, lower than index 2 so merit falls off past Pb~0.68
Wide-gap phases unlikely to absorb 2.4 eV photons, and merit was already falling toward the Sb side at index 8
